scripts.test: echo '[DEBUG] Architecture check:' && uname -m && arch && echo '[DEBUG] Node binary arch:' && file $(which node) && echo '[DEBUG] Try different node invocations:' && $(which node) --version 2>&1 || echo 'Direct invoke failed' && /usr/bin/env node --version 2>&1 || echo 'env node failed' && command -v node && vitest --typecheck.enabled 2>&1 || echo '[DEBUG] vitest also failed with:' $?
